tools.version: 18b7be9 2026-02-08; VideoLabs' 2024-03-07 build of VLC 4.0.0-dev (experimental.wasm, 27 MB; no build scripts, cannot be rebuilt)
tools.obtained: git clone --depth 1 into .research/vlc.js; served by its own Vite config (COOP same-origin, COEP credentialless) and driven through its own UI (#input-file, #canvas). Unmodified.

tools.label: addyosmani/webvlc
tools.obtained: git clone --depth 1 into .research/webvlc, npm i && npx vite build; its production build is served and driven through its file input. It never loads the first video opened in a fresh page, so each file is opened twice and the second attempt measured.
tools.notes: A React UI over the browser's own <video>/<audio>; no wasm. Production build. Picture = luma variance > 20 on the <video>; audio = signal on an analyser fed by captureStream (Chrome) / mozCaptureStream (Firefox), else decoded audio while playing (webkitAudioDecodedByteCount, mozHasAudio, or in WebKit an audio track present while currentTime advances).
